story: A god of forests and birds was the son of the sky father and the earth mother, who once lay in a tight embrace, their many children living in darkness between them. The children grew frustrated at their confinement. One brother, the future god of war, proposed killing their parents, but this god disagreed, suggesting instead that they separate them, sending the sky father upward and leaving the earth mother below. Several brothers tried and failed to part them. Finally, this god lay on his back and pushed with his strong legs, forcing his parents apart, and the sky father rose high above. The god then searched for heavenly lights so his father would be properly adorned, obtaining the stars, moon, and sun and casting them into the sky. Another brother, god of storms, was angry at the separation and joined the sky father, punishing the earth with violent storms, attacking the forests and shattering trees, then attacking the sea, causing the sea god to flee. The sea god's descendants split, some fleeing into the sea as fish, others into the forests as reptiles. Ever since, the sea god has resented the forest god for hiding his children. The forest god gave humans canoes, hooks, and nets to catch fish, while the sea god retaliated with floods and overturned canoes. Later, this god sought a wife, first fathering insects, birds, and plants with non-human females, then molding a woman from soil. He married his daughter without her knowing his identity; upon discovering the truth, she fled to the underworld and became the goddess of death, telling him to raise their children while she awaited them below. He also brought down three baskets of knowledge from the heavens.
